name: webxr-interactions-workspace
description: Workspace for the Reality Collective WebXR Interaction Extensions - an engine-free interaction core for WebXR, with three.js, Meta IWSDK and Google XR Blocks adapters and a demo playground.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @realitycollective/webxr-interactions run build && npm --workspace @realitycollective/threejs-interactions run build && npm --workspace @realitycollective/iwsdk-interactions run build && npm --workspace @realitycollective/xrblocks-interactions run build
scripts.build:playground: npm run build && npm --workspace playground-demo run build
